title: Population Cages with Permuted Diet
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rq3d5yn
materials: Two addition population cage studies were then completed.

steps.title: Prepare Fruit Diet
steps.instruction: Construct the fruit diet by adding 150 g of passionfruit or banana to a standard base.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the standard base contains 1% agar, 0.1% nipagen, 0.1% propionic acid, and 0.001% phosphoric acid.

steps.title: Maintain Population Cages with Permuted Diet
steps.instruction: Maintain the population cages over 26 generations using a permuted diet schedule.

substeps.instruction: Feed generations 1-4 the 1:2 P:C laboratory diet.
For the first cage study, replace the laboratory diet with natural fruits.

steps.title: Determine mtDNA Frequency
steps.instruction: Determine the mtDNA frequency of larvae harbouring Dahomey or Alstonville mtDNA using allele-specific PCR and Sanger sequencing.
